statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
